calibration.calibration_description: Evaluates alignment between predicted confidence scores and empirical event frequencies. Lower Brier score and ECE indicate superior probability calibration.

false_alarm_analysis.alert_merging_rule: Contiguous false-positive minutes within the same episode are grouped into a single alert incident. Merged incidents combine alerts with gaps <= 5 minutes.
